English: Painted Panel Nook
A humble corner tent or lean-to sheltering a traveling icon, fostering devotion among the nomads.
Wooden Icon Stand
A simple wooden frame allows icons to be displayed at gatherings, reinforcing shared faith and unity.
Gold Leaf Shrine
A mobile tent adorned with gold-leafed icons, drawing pilgrims and reinforcing spiritual authority.
Iconographers Pavilion
A grand tent dedicated to the creation and veneration of icons, serving as a focal point for holy gatherings.
Sacred Image Room
A semi-permanent wooden structure, richly adorned, where sacred icons are displayed and guarded by priests.
Sanctified Hall
A solid wooden or stone-floored hall, sanctified by patriarchal blessing, hosting major religious rites for the clan.
Altar of Relics
A secure enclosure for venerated relics, drawing pilgrims and cementing the clans pious reputation.
Priests Sanctuary
A lavishly appointed sanctuary for the clans priests, supporting elaborate rituals and fostering deeper unity.
Iconostasis
A grand partition of icons and relics, forming both a spiritual and social center for the nomad court.
Byzantine Icon Hall
A semi-permanent stone hall patterned on Byzantine basilicas, adorned with priceless icons, relics, and goldwork, inspiring awe and unity across the horde.
